Crayon Kid — https://crayonkid.mehyar.us/

Crayon Kid is an AI coloring book generator made by Mehyar Soft. It creates
personalized coloring books for kids: the kid's name appears on every page.

PRICING
- 1 personalized coloring page: FREE, no account, no credit card
- Full 12-page personalized coloring book (high-resolution print PDF): $6
  one-time payment via Stripe. No subscription, no upsells. Unlimited printing
  for your own family.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter the kid's first name and pick how to create the page: choose one of
   8 themes (dinosaurs, space, ocean, jungle, unicorns, vehicles, farm,
   princess), describe anything in your own words, or upload a photo to be
   redrawn as a coloring page.
2. Pick a detail level (Simple for ages 3–5, Detailed for ages 6+).
3. Enter the parent's email — the free page is generated instantly and the
   setup is saved so a link can bring you back to checkout later.
4. Pay $6 via Stripe to unlock the full 12-page PDF (US Letter, print-quality
   raster art), delivered instantly.

SAMPLES (real pages made with Crayon Kid)

PRIVACY SUMMARY
Uploaded photos are processed in memory to draw the page and are never stored
or shared. The coloring pages we generate are cached briefly (up to 30 days)
so we can email and show your free page. Emails are used only for your free
page, checkout reminders, and purchase receipts — no spam. Full details at
https://crayonkid.mehyar.us/privacy.html
